provisional_routing: Use Luna low/medium or Terra medium for narrow docs/status/lifecycle work.
Use Terra medium for routine implementation/debugging; escalate to Terra high when justified.
Prefer Sol medium for safety/security/provenance/secret-boundary review on evidence similar to this benchmark.
For high-confidence safety review, consider independent Sol medium plus Luna medium before a single Luna xhigh pass.
Treat Luna xhigh as exceptional maximum-recall work, not a default.
Do not default Terra xhigh from this benchmark; Terra high had the same confirmed code recall more cheaply.
Do not default Luna high from this benchmark; it did not improve total confirmed recall over Luna medium.
Do not infer a universal model ordering from one safety-heavy benchmark.
limitations: Single real task, safety-heavy rather than representative of all implementation/debugging/documentation work.
Model outputs are stochastic; one run per model/effort cell does not establish stable medians.
Sol high/xhigh were not tested in this benchmark.
Later effort runs reused the original verified GitHub snapshot to preserve prompt identity after live main advanced.
